source: plate metadata only (sample -> well -> drug map); no expression data or scores were read
rule: eligible = targeted drug at >= 2 positions over the 14 plates with >= 1 pair at different wells on different plates that includes a new plate; EGFR excluded (no carriers). A drug that later gets no g from disjoint halves is reported as not testable, not dropped silently.
criterion: per drug: carrier-line mean of (g+t disjoint - uncorrected), one-sided Wilcoxon over lines, p<0.05, treated-well reference primary; success if >= 2/3 of eligible drugs gain. If fewer than 3 eligible: one pooled test over the carrier lines of all eligible drugs; if 1, its own line-level test.
